title: Change Passport v1
description: The one object that travels from BrotherMode (execution provenance) to BrotherSBE (assurance), per docs/NORTH-STAR-CHAIN.md, section 'The change passport, in full'. Five readable fields at top level, plus the change identity and the producer's own detail records that back them up. Unknown top-level keys are ignored by the consumer, so a producer may add its own detail without breaking the contract; this schema still names the ones this producer actually writes.

schema.description: The one and only version marker. Unrecognised by the consumer (it checks no version key at all), read by everything else that opens this file by hand.

sensitivity.description: Which export policy produced this document (cross-family review 2026-08-20, F1). "redacted" (the default) routed every store-derived free text field through tools/bm_store.py's own export_column policy, so founder-typed prose that policy withholds is DROPPED from this document rather than shown as a placeholder. "raw" means --include-sensitive was passed: this document carries unredacted store text and needs the same handling as the store itself.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, seconds precision. The only generation timestamp in the document; nothing else in this file states when it was produced.

whatWasDone.description: Field 1. Plain-language lines a reviewer needs to find the work: the change identity, the commit range, the files touched. Derived from `change` at generation time.

whoDidIt.description: Field 2. Which sessions wrote, which claims they held, and the human accountable for the result, by name. Derived from `details.who`. Carried ONLY through this deposit; the consumer has no other source for it.

whatWasRun.description: Field 3. Every verification executed after the last edit, its result, and whether a build system or a laptop produced it. Derived from `details.evidence`.

whatWasNotEstablished.description: Field 4. MANDATORY, never empty: the executing side's own honest list of what it did not check. Derived from `details.notEstablished`, including its none-claim escape.

whereItCameFrom.description: Field 5. The development method used, named and not judged. Derived from `details.method`. Carried ONLY through this deposit.

repo.description: The repository identity: its origin remote URL, or the directory name when no remote is configured.

projectId.description: The BrotherMode store project id this change was generated for (cross-family review 2026-08-20, F9), always carried whether or not the project was actually found in the store.

baseCommit.description: The start of the change range.

headCommit.description: The end of the change range.

filesTouched.description: Every file path changed between baseCommit and headCommit, sorted. May be empty when the range touches nothing.

accountableHuman.description: A name, never a role. Accountability is a person, per the chain's own rule.

origin.description: Whether a build system or somebody's laptop produced this evidence. Provenance of evidence is part of the evidence.

ciRunId.description: Optional. Present only when a build system claims the run; its absence is itself meaningful and is never invented.

noneClaimJustification.description: Null unless `items` is empty. A literal claim that nothing was left unestablished needs its own justification; the pairing is enforced by the validator, not by this schema alone, because JSON Schema cannot cheaply express 'empty implies non-null sibling' without an if/then that most readers of this file would find harder to follow than the validator's own plain code.

commitish.description: A hex commit id, short or full.
